fieldValues.title: Decision framing rules apply as a convention first
fieldValues.decision_question: How are the framing rules for decisions introduced?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Decision records follow four framing rules: one thing per record, a timeless statement, a review condition that can be observed, and, for design decisions, a cited design principle or a named exception; the rules apply as a convention first, and the session recorder warns without blocking.
fieldValues.rationale: Applies the standing preference Convention before enforcement: a rule that arrives already tried is cheaper than one enforced and wrong.
fieldValues.revisit_when: After the warnings have run over several sessions: are they acted on? If they are, a later decision enforces the rules.
